1) 执行 rndc dumpdb -all 后在 dump 文件里查看响应慢的: 1) Run rndc dumpdb -all and inspect the dump file for slow upstream servers; 2) From the BIND host run dig @<authoritative IP> plus ping/mtr to separate an upstream outage from packet loss on this host's egress; 3) If IPv6 is unreachable and causing the timeouts, add -4 to the named start-up arguments or disable outbound IPv6 queries; 4) Longer term, add forwarders and enable forward first to reduce the share of queries recursed directly to authoritative servers.
1) 执行 rndc querylog 打开查询日志（排查完记得再执行一次关闭）: 1) Run rndc querylog to turn on query logging (remember to run it again to turn it off afterwards) and find the domains that dominate the errors in the named log; 2) Run dig +trace @127.0.0.1 <domain> against that domain to tell whether the upstream authoritative server is unreachable, DNSSEC validation is failing, or a forwarder is broken; 3) For DNSSEC failures, verify with dig +cd first, then fix the trust anchor or temporarily add a negative-trust-anchor for that zone; 4) For forwarder problems, check that the servers in forwarders are reachable and switch to a backup DNS server.
1) 执行 rndc status 查看 recursive clients 的: 1) Run rndc status to see the live recursive client count and the configured limit; 2) Spot-check a few slow domains with dig +trace to determine whether a slow upstream authoritative server is causing recursive requests to pile up; 3) Once confirmed, raise recursive-clients in options (re-checking memory) and run rndc reload; 4) If malicious queries are filling the quota, configure response-rate-limit and tighten the source networks allowed by allow-recursion.
1) 查看 named 日志里 client 相关的 dropped 记录，确认: 1) Look for client-related dropped entries in the named log and identify the source IPs and query names being dropped; 2) If the source is a legitimate business network, check whether the allow-query / allow-recursion ACLs are missing that range; 3) If the sources are scattered and the query names look random, treat it as a random-subdomain attack: enable response-rate-limit and consider adding a fetches-per-zone limit; 4) After changing the configuration, validate it with named-checkconf before running rndc reload.
1) 立即执行 rndc status 确认 recursive clients: 1) Run rndc status immediately to confirm recursive client usage; 2) Run rndc recursing to dump the queries currently being resolved and identify the domain or client consuming the quota; 3) As an emergency measure raise recursive-clients and run rndc reload to restore service; 4) Afterwards check the health of the upstream authoritative servers for the domain you identified, or restrict the offending source IPs with allow-recursion or RRL.
BIND 主动丢弃了客户端查询（QryDropped），通常由 ACL 拒绝、配: BIND actively dropped client queries (QryDropped), normally triggered by an ACL rejection, a quota limit, or malformed requests. The affected clients see resolution timeouts.
BIND 因为触达 recursive-clients 上限已开始直接丢弃递归查: BIND has started dropping recursive queries outright because it hit the recursive-clients limit. Clients receive resolution timeouts, so traffic is already being lost.
BIND 应答 SERVFAIL 占比过高: BIND SERVFAIL response ratio too high
BIND 达到递归客户端上限并丢弃查询: BIND hit the recursive client limit and is dropping queries
BIND 递归客户端数逼近上限: BIND recursive clients approaching the limit
BIND 递归查询超时率过高: BIND recursive query timeout ratio too high
当前并发递归客户端数已超过 900（recursive-clients 默认上限: Concurrent recursive clients have passed 900 (recursive-clients defaults to a limit of 1000). Any further growth means new recursive queries start being dropped.
最近 5 分钟 BIND 发往上游权威的递归查询有超过 10% 超时，解析延迟会: Over the last 5 minutes more than 10% of the recursive queries BIND sent to upstream authoritative servers timed out. Resolution latency will rise sharply and eventually surface as SERVFAIL.
最近 5 分钟 BIND 返回 SERVFAIL 的应答占比超过 5%，说明大量: Over the last 5 minutes more than 5% of BIND responses were SERVFAIL, meaning many name lookups are failing and services that depend on this DNS server will see random connection failures.
